packageRules.description: The Python of CI (setup-python's python-version in test.yml and release.yml) stays below 3.14: unstructured (the extra loaders) requires Python <3.14 in every release since 0.20.2 (0.24.0 too, up to 0.27.37 of 2026-11-06), so pip finds no unstructured on a newer Python. Remove this rule once a release of unstructured allows 3.14 or later
